sup:DEMO-F1.text:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. 

As a family-run foundry, we deeply value our long relationship and take great pride in the dedication of our skilled team. In light of current market conditions, WAGES-METAL rose 3.1 % in twelve months and is 28 % of our cost. 

We are pleased to submit our offer at a price of €52.90 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, valid from 1 December 2026. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

We look forward to continuing our trustful cooperation and working together with you.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

move.text:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. 

We appreciate your willingness to commit to a 24-month contract, which allows us to offer a slight reduction in price. However, the prices you have proposed are far below our production costs and do not reflect the current market realities, particularly the recent wage increases. Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal. 

We can offer €52.30 for a 24-month term with 30-day payment terms, which represents a fair compromise while ensuring the continued quality and reliability you expect from us. For our Angebot, this is a price of €52.30 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

move.text:
Guten Tag,

We appreciate your revised offers and your willingness to move closer to a sustainable agreement. We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. Our updated offer stands at a price of €51.70 per unit, a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 February 2027. 

Please understand that our skilled team's wages and our energy costs strictly limit our flexibility, making this a significant concession. It has always been a matter of pride for our family foundry to work closely with valued partners in our region, and we hope this proposal reflects our deep commitment to our shared future. 

Kindly note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. We look forward to your response.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

move.text:
Guten Tag,

It is always a pleasure to deal with our valued partners, and we have reviewed your offer carefully. As a family foundry deeply rooted in our region, we take immense pride in our craftsmanship and the long relationship we share with you. 

We can adjust our Angebot as follows: we present a price of €51.00 per unit, a Zahlungsziel of 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, and this will be valid from 1 February 2027. To reciprocate your movement, we are prepared to lower our price to €51.00 for the 30-day payment term. 

This substantial concession reflects our dedication to finding a mutually beneficial agreement despite our strict cost limitations. Please understand that our price reflects our costs, and our calculation stays internal. Furthermore, this offer stays valid for 30 days.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

move.text:
Guten Tag,

We acknowledge your revised offer and appreciate your continued movement. This step reflects our deep commitment to our long-standing partnership, despite the strict limits imposed by our costs.

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. 

Our offer stands at a price of €50.40 per unit, a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, and a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 February 2027. Please note that this offer stays valid for 7 days.

Our foundry has taken great pride in serving your business over many years, and we remain dedicated to maintaining the high quality of craftsmanship that our region is known for. We truly hope we can continue our shared path together.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH
